name: AI Governance and Risk Management: NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001
description: A practitioner's course in building AI governance that works: inventory, intake, risk tiering, impact assessment, lifecycle controls and leadership reporting, anchored to NIST AI RMF 1.0, its Generative AI Profile and ISO/IEC 42001. Ends with a 90-day program build plan and ready-to-adapt templates.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI Governance and Risk Management: NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 18 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
